name: Zhejiang Wanfeng Auto Wheel Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Wanfeng Auto Wheel Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of automotive parts and aircrafts in China. The company offers services and labor for automobile aluminum alloy wheels and motorcycle aluminum alloy wheels and other parts; lightweight magnesium materials and components for automobiles and motorcycles; technical services of metal, non-metallic materials and their products, karts, and environmental protection equipment; and coating technology services.
